title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
请您帮帮忙

    高老汉一个晚上没有睡觉，一直在说：“他们怎么还不回来，他们怎么还不回来。”他等不了了，第二天一大早，他决定自己去区里找大黑和小二黑。
    刚出门不久，远远地看到大黑回来了，高老汉忙跑过去，大声问道：“大黑，怎么样？打听到什么了？”
    大黑笑着说：“爸，没事，别怕！区长要我找你和三花到区里问话。你去吧，没事的。二黑和多喜两个人一到区里就被放开了。区里早就听说大南和小南不是好人，已经把他们关起来了。他们还要来我们村调查大南和小南呢。我到了区里，他们就问了我一些问题，听说区里还让我们二黑跟多喜结婚呢！”
    高老汉放心了，说：“没事就好，但是结婚可不行。算命书上说了，他们的生日不适合结婚。对了，你有没有问问区里让我去干什么？”
    大黑说：“我没问，但应该没有什么大事。你先去吧！我回去告诉妈妈，让她放心。然后，我还要去找三花，让她也到区里去。”说完就走了。
    高老汉到了区里，看见小二黑和多喜坐在椅子上。他一上去就打小二黑：“你这个坏东西！让我担心了那么久，真是个坏东西！”
    区长看不下去了：“干什么？干什么？这里不能打人啊！”
    高老汉不说话了。
    区长问：“你就是高二黑的爸爸吗？”
    高老汉回答：“是的。”
    “听说你给高二黑收了个小女孩，要让他们结婚？”
    “是的！”
    “那小女孩今年几岁了？”
    “她三年前来我们家的，现在十二岁了。”
    区长站起来说：“女的不到十五岁不能结婚，明白吗？你快把那小女孩送回她家去吧！高二黑想和多喜结婚！”
    高老汉有点害怕，说：“她只有个爸爸，不知道跑去哪里了。她没有家，我不知道要把她送到哪里去呀！女的不到十五岁不能结婚，说是这么说，没错！但区长您也知道，村里面收小女孩，然后让他们长大后结婚，这样的事情很多呀。区长您帮帮忙，您不说什么，这件事也就这么过去了……”
    “不行！结婚是两个人的事。只要有一个人不愿意，就不能结婚！”区长有点生气。
    高老汉说：“没关系，这是我们都愿意的。”
    “都愿意？”区长看向小二黑，问道：“高二黑，你愿意和你家里的那个小女孩结婚吗？”
    小二黑大声说道：“不愿意！”
    高老汉生气了，看向小二黑，声音也大了很多：“别说话！这事儿不是你能决定的！”
    “那是你决定吗？”区长说，“他结婚，不是他决定还是你决定吗？老汉啊，你知道吗，现在和以前不一样了，现在已经不是爸爸妈妈决定孩子和谁结婚了，孩子们可以自己决定和谁约会，和谁结婚。你家养的那小女孩，要是真没有家，就算成你的女儿好了。”
    高老汉看到区长这么说了，没办法，说道：“他不想和我家那小女孩结婚也可以。不过，还请区长帮帮忙，不要让他和三花的女儿结婚呀！”
    区长说：“这个我管不了啊。”
    高老汉急得想哭了：“不行啊，不行啊！他们的生日不适合结婚，算命书上说的，真的不能结婚啊！请区长帮帮忙吧！”然后，他又看向小二黑说：“二黑啊，你们的生日我算了很多次，真的不适合结婚啊！”
    “不适合？”区长说，“你让一个十九岁的孩子和你那十二岁的小女孩结婚，那才是不适合吧？其实，只要高二黑和多喜两个人愿意结婚，你同意也好，不同意也好，都没什么关系。快回去吧！”说完，让人把高老汉带出去了。

請您幫幫忙

    高老漢一個晚上沒有睡覺，一直在說：“他們怎麼還不回來，他們怎麼還不回來。”他等不了了，第二天一大早，他決定自己去區裡找大黑和小二黑。
    剛出門不久，遠遠地看到大黑回來了，高老漢忙跑過去，大聲問道：“大黑，怎麼樣？打聽到什麼了？”
    大黑笑著說：“爸，沒事，別怕！區長要我找你和三花到區裡問話。你去吧，沒事的。二黑和多喜兩個人一到區裡就被放開了。區裡早就聽說大南和小南不是好人，已經把他們關起來了。他們還要來我們村調查大南和小南呢。我到了區裡，他們就問了我一些問題，聽說區裡還讓我們二黑跟多喜結婚呢！”
    高老漢放心了，說：“沒事就好，但是結婚可不行。算命書上說了，他們的生日不適合結婚。對了，你有沒有問問區裡讓我去幹什麼？”
    大黑說：“我沒問，但應該沒有什麼大事。你先去吧！我回去告訴媽媽，讓她放心。然後，我還要去找三花，讓她也到區裡去。”說完就走了。
    高老漢到了區裡，看見小二黑和多喜坐在椅子上。他一上去就打小二黑：“你這個壞東西！讓我擔心了那麼久，真是個壞東西！”
    區長看不下去了：“幹什麼？幹什麼？這裡不能打人啊！”
    高老漢不說話了。
    區長問：“你就是高二黑的爸爸嗎？”
    高老漢回答：“是的。”
    “聽說你給高二黑收了個小女孩，要讓他們結婚？”
    “是的！”
    “那小女孩今年幾歲了？”
    “她三年前來我們家的，現在十二歲了。”
    區長站起來說：“女的不到十五歲不能結婚，明白嗎？你快把那小女孩送回她家去吧！高二黑想和多喜結婚！”
    高老漢有點害怕，說：“她只有個爸爸，不知道跑去哪裏了。她沒有家，我不知道要把她送到哪裏去呀！女的不到十五歲不能結婚，說是這麼說，沒錯！但區長您也知道，村裡面收小女孩，然後讓他們長大後結婚，這樣的事情很多呀。區長您幫幫忙，您不說什麼，這件事也就這麼過去了……”
    “不行！結婚是兩個人的事。只要有一個人不願意，就不能結婚！”區長有點生氣。
    高老漢說：“沒關係，這是我們都願意的。”
    “都願意？”區長看向小二黑，問道：“高二黑，你願意和你家裡的那個小女孩結婚嗎？”
    小二黑大聲說道：“不願意！”
    高老漢生氣了，看向小二黑，聲音也大了很多：“別說話！這事兒不是你能決定的！”
    “那是你決定嗎？”區長說，“他結婚，不是他決定還是你決定嗎？老漢啊，你知道嗎，現在和以前不一樣了，現在已經不是爸爸媽媽決定孩子和誰結婚了，孩子們可以自己決定和誰約會，和誰結婚。你家養的那小女孩，要是真沒有家，就算成你的女兒好了。”
    高老漢看到區長這麼說了，沒辦法，說道：“他不想和我家那小女孩結婚也可以。不過，還請區長幫幫忙，不要讓他和三花的女兒結婚呀！”
    區長說：“這個我管不了啊。”
    高老漢急得想哭了：“不行啊，不行啊！他們的生日不適合結婚，算命書上說的，真的不能結婚啊！請區長幫幫忙吧！”然後，他又看向小二黑說：“二黑啊，你們的生日我算了很多次，真的不適合結婚啊！”
    “不適合？”區長說，“你讓一個十九歲的孩子和你那十二歲的小女孩結婚，那才是不適合吧？其實，只要高二黑和多喜兩個人願意結婚，你同意也好，不同意也好，都沒什麼關係。快回去吧！”說完，讓人把高老漢帶出去了。

sentences.traditional: 高老漢有點害怕，說：“她只有個爸爸，不知道跑去哪裏了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn yǒu diǎn hài pà shuō tā zhǐ yǒu ge bà ba bù zhī dào pǎo qù nǎ lǐ le
sentences.english: Gao Laohan was a little scared and said, “She only has a father, and I don’t know where he went.

sentences.simplified: 她没有家，我不知道要把她送到哪里去呀！
sentences.traditional: 她沒有家，我不知道要把她送到哪裏去呀！
sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu jiā wǒ bù zhī dào yào bǎ tā sòng dào nǎ lǐ qù ya
sentences.english: She doesn’t have a home. I don’t know where to send her back to!

sentences.simplified: 女的不到十五岁不能结婚，说是这么说，没错！
sentences.traditional: 女的不到十五歲不能結婚，說是這麼說，沒錯！
sentences.pinyin: nǚ de bú dào shí wǔ suì bù néng jié hūn shuō shì zhè me shuō méi cuò
sentences.english: Girls can’t marry until they are fifteen … well yes, that’s technically true!

sentences.simplified: 但区长您也知道，村里面收小女孩，然后让他们长大后结婚，这样的事情很多呀。
sentences.traditional: 但區長您也知道，村裡面收小女孩，然後讓他們長大後結婚，這樣的事情很多呀。
sentences.pinyin: dàn qū zhǎng nín yě zhī dào cūn lǐ miàn shōu xiǎo nǚ hái rán hòu ràng tā men zhǎng dà hòu jié hūn zhè yàng de shì qing hěn duō ya
sentences.english: But District Chief, you know that in the village it’s very common to obtain a little girl and then marry them after they grow up.

sentences.simplified: 区长您帮帮忙，您不说什么，这件事也就这么过去了……”
sentences.traditional: 區長您幫幫忙，您不說什麼，這件事也就這麼過去了……”
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng nín bāng bang máng nín bù shuō shén me zhè jiàn shì yě jiù zhè me guò qù le
sentences.english: District Chief, please help us out. If you don’t say anything, then it will end like this …”

sentences.simplified: “不行！结婚是两个人的事。只要有一个人不愿意，就不能结婚！”
sentences.traditional: “不行！結婚是兩個人的事。只要有一個人不願意，就不能結婚！”
sentences.pinyin: bù xíng jié hūn shì liǎng ge rén de shì zhǐ yào yǒu yí ge rén bú yuàn yì jiù bù néng jié hūn
sentences.english: “No way! Marriage is between two people. If one person is unwilling, then the marriage cannot happen!”

sentences.simplified: 区长有点生气。
sentences.traditional: 區長有點生氣。
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng yǒu diǎn shēng qì
sentences.english: The district chief was a little angry.

sentences.simplified: 高老汉说：“没关系，这是我们都愿意的。”
sentences.traditional: 高老漢說：“沒關係，這是我們都願意的。”
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn shuō méi guān xi zhè shì wǒ men dōu yuàn yì de
sentences.english: Gao Laohan said, “It’s okay. In this case, everyone is willing.”

sentences.simplified: “都愿意？”区长看向小二黑，问道：
sentences.traditional: “都願意？”區長看向小二黑，問道：
sentences.pinyin: dōu yuàn yì qū zhǎng kàn xiàng xiǎo èr hēi wèn dào
sentences.english: “Everyone is willing?” The district chief looked towards Little Erhei and asked, ..

sentences.simplified: “高二黑，你愿意和你家里的那个小女孩结婚吗？”
sentences.traditional: “高二黑，你願意和你家裡的那個小女孩結婚嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: gāo èr hēi nǐ yuàn yì hé nǐ jiā lǐ de nà ge xiǎo nǚ hái jié hūn ma
sentences.english: .. “Gao Erhei, are you willing to get married to the little girl in your home?”

sentences.simplified: 小二黑大声说道：“不愿意！”
sentences.traditional: 小二黑大聲說道：“不願意！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo èr hēi dà shēng shuō dào bú yuàn yì
sentences.english: Little Erhei said loudly, “No, I am not willing!”

sentences.simplified: 高老汉生气了，看向小二黑，声音也大了很多：
sentences.traditional: 高老漢生氣了，看向小二黑，聲音也大了很多：
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn shēng qì le kàn xiàng xiǎo èr hēi shēng yīn yě dà le hěn duō
sentences.english: Gao Laohan became angry, looked towards Little Erhei, and spoke much more loudly, ..

sentences.simplified: “别说话！这事儿不是你能决定的！”
sentences.traditional: “別說話！這事兒不是你能決定的！”
sentences.pinyin: bié shuō huà zhè shì'r bú shì nǐ néng jué dìng de
sentences.english: .. “Don’t say a word! This matter is not for you to decide!”

sentences.simplified: “那是你决定吗？”区长说，
sentences.traditional: “那是你決定嗎？”區長說，
sentences.pinyin: nà shì nǐ jué dìng ma qū zhǎng shuō
sentences.english: “Then is it for you to decide?” The district chief said, ..

sentences.simplified: “他结婚，不是他决定还是你决定吗？
sentences.traditional: “他結婚，不是他決定還是你決定嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā jié hūn bú shì tā jué dìng hái shi nǐ jué dìng ma
sentences.english: .. “His own marriage is not up for him to decide yet it’s up to you to decide?

sentences.simplified: 老汉啊，你知道吗，现在和以前不一样了，
sentences.traditional: 老漢啊，你知道嗎，現在和以前不一樣了，
sentences.pinyin: lǎo hàn a nǐ zhī dào ma xiàn zài hé yǐ qián bù yí yàng le
sentences.english: Oh, Laohan, did you know, things are different now than they were in the past?

sentences.simplified: 现在已经不是爸爸妈妈决定孩子和谁结婚了，
sentences.traditional: 現在已經不是爸爸媽媽決定孩子和誰結婚了，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài yǐ jīng bú shì bà ba mā ma jué dìng hái zi hé shéi jié hūn le
sentences.english: Now it’s no longer up to the parents to decide to whom their children get married.

sentences.simplified: 孩子们可以自己决定和谁约会，和谁结婚。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們可以自己決定和誰約會，和誰結婚。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi men kě yǐ zì jǐ jué dìng hé shéi yuē huì hé shéi jié hūn
sentences.english: Children can decide whom they date and whom they marry.

sentences.simplified: 你家养的那小女孩，要是真没有家，就算成你的女儿好了。”
sentences.traditional: 你家養的那小女孩，要是真沒有家，就算成你的女兒好了。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jiā yǎng de nà xiǎo nǚ hái yào shi zhēn méi yǒu jiā jiù suàn chéng nǐ de nǚ ér hǎo le
sentences.english: The little girl you are raising, if she really doesn’t have a home, then she can just be your daughter.”

sentences.simplified: 高老汉看到区长这么说了，没办法，
sentences.traditional: 高老漢看到區長這麼說了，沒辦法，
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn kàn dào qū zhǎng zhè me shuō le méi bàn fǎ
sentences.english: Gao Laohan heard what the district chief had to say and had nothing to counter with.

sentences.simplified: 说道：“他不想和我家那小女孩结婚也可以。
sentences.traditional: 說道：“他不想和我家那小女孩結婚也可以。
sentences.pinyin: shuō dào tā bù xiǎng hé wǒ jiā nà xiǎo nǚ hái jié hūn yě kě yǐ
sentences.english: He said, “It’s fine if he doesn’t want to get married to the little girl in my home.

sentences.simplified: 不过，还请区长帮帮忙，不要让他和三花的女儿结婚呀！”
sentences.traditional: 不過，還請區長幫幫忙，不要讓他和三花的女兒結婚呀！”
sentences.pinyin: bú guò hái qǐng qū zhǎng bāng bang máng bú yào ràng tā hé sān huā de nǚ ér jié hūn ya
sentences.english: But District Chief, please do me a favor. Don’t let him get married to Sanhua’s daughter!”

sentences.simplified: 区长说：“这个我管不了啊。”
sentences.traditional: 區長說：“這個我管不了啊。”
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng shuō zhè ge wǒ guǎn bù liǎo a
sentences.english: The district chief said, “But this is not something I can control.”

sentences.simplified: 高老汉急得想哭了：
sentences.traditional: 高老漢急得想哭了：
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn jí de xiǎng kū le
sentences.english: Gao Laohan was so worried he wanted to cry,

sentences.simplified: “不行啊，不行啊！他们的生日不适合结婚，算命书上说的，
sentences.traditional: “不行啊，不行啊！他們的生日不適合結婚，算命書上說的，
sentences.pinyin: bù xíng a bù xíng a tā men de shēng rì bú shì hé jié hūn suàn mìng shū shang shuō de
sentences.english: “No! No! Their birthdays are not suitable for marriage. It says so in the fortune-telling book!

sentences.simplified: 真的不能结婚啊！请区长帮帮忙吧！”
sentences.traditional: 真的不能結婚啊！請區長幫幫忙吧！”
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de bù néng jié hūn a qǐng qū zhǎng bāng bang máng ba
sentences.english: They really can’t get married! Please help me, District Chief!”

sentences.simplified: 然后，他又看向小二黑说：
sentences.traditional: 然後，他又看向小二黑說：
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tā yòu kàn xiàng xiǎo èr hēi shuō
sentences.english: Then, he turned towards Little Erhei and said, ..

sentences.simplified: “二黑啊，你们的生日我算了很多次，真的不适合结婚啊！”
sentences.traditional: “二黑啊，你們的生日我算了很多次，真的不適合結婚啊！”
sentences.pinyin: èr hēi a nǐ men de shēng rì wǒ suàn le hěn duō cì zhēn de bú shì hé jié hūn a
sentences.english: .. “Erhei, I’ve read the fortunes for your birthdays many times; they’re really not suitable for marriage!”

sentences.simplified: “不适合？”区长说，
sentences.traditional: “不適合？”區長說，
sentences.pinyin: bú shì hé qū zhǎng shuō
sentences.english: “Not suitable?” The district chief said, ..

sentences.simplified: “你让一个十九岁的孩子和你那十二岁的小女孩结婚，
sentences.traditional: “你讓一個十九歲的孩子和你那十二歲的小女孩結婚，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ ràng yí ge shí jiǔ suì de hái zi hé nǐ nà shí èr suì de xiǎo nǚ hái jié hūn
sentences.english: .. “You want a nineteen-year-old child to marry that twelve-year-old little girl of yours.

sentences.simplified: 那才是不适合吧？
sentences.traditional: 那才是不適合吧？
sentences.pinyin: nà cái shì bú shì hé ba
sentences.english: Surely, this is what is not suitable?

sentences.simplified: 其实，只要高二黑和多喜两个人愿意结婚，
sentences.traditional: 其實，只要高二黑和多喜兩個人願意結婚，
sentences.pinyin: qí shí zhǐ yào gāo èr hēi hé duō xǐ liǎng ge rén yuàn yì jié hūn
sentences.english: In reality, as long as Gao Erhei and Duoxi want to get married, ..

sentences.simplified: 你同意也好，不同意也好，都没什么关系。快回去吧！”
sentences.traditional: 你同意也好，不同意也好，都沒什麼關係。快回去吧！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ tóng yì yě hǎo bù tóng yì yě hǎo dōu méi shén me guān xi kuài huí qù ba
sentences.english: .. it doesn’t matter whether you agree or disagree. Go home now!”

sentences.simplified: 说完，让人把高老汉带出去了。
sentences.traditional: 說完，讓人把高老漢帶出去了。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán ràng rén bǎ gāo lǎo hàn dài chū qù le
sentences.english: After he finished speaking, he had someone see Gao Laohan out.

raw.synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.
sentence_translations: Please Help Me Out
Gao Laohan didn’t sleep for the entire night. He kept saying, “Why aren’t they back yet? Why aren’t they back yet?”
He couldn’t wait any longer, so first thing the next morning, ..
.. he decided to go to the district to look for Big Hei and Little Erhei.
Not long after he left the house, he saw from afar that Big Hei had come back.
Gao Laohan hurriedly ran over and asked loudly, “Big Hei, how was it? Did you find out anything?”
Big Hei said, smiling, “Dad, nothing’s wrong. Don’t worry!
The district chief wants to see you and Sanhua to ask some questions. You can go, don’t worry about it.
Erhei and Duoxi were both released as soon as they arrived in the district.
The district had previously heard that Big Nan and Little Nan were not good people, ..
..  and has locked them up.
They even want to come to our village to investigate Big Nan and Little Nan.
After I got to the district, they asked me some questions.
I heard that the district will allow our Erhei to marry Duoxi!”
Gao Laohan was relieved and said, “It’s good to hear that nothing is wrong, but marriage is out of the question.
It says in the fortune-telling book that their birthdays are not suitable for marriage.
Oh, by the way, did you ask why they want me to go to the district?”
Big Hei said, “I didn’t ask, but it probably isn’t anything major. You go ahead!
I’m going to go back and tell Mom so she doesn’t worry. Then, I’ll go find Sanhua and tell her to go to the district.”
After saying this, Big Hei left.
Gao Laohan arrived in the district, and saw Little Erhei and Duoxi sitting in chairs.
He went up and hit Little Erhei, “You scoundrel! You had me worried for so long. You really are a scoundrel!”
The district chief couldn’t bear it any longer, “What are you doing? What are you doing? You can’t hit people here!”
Gao Laohan didn’t say anything.
The district chief asked, “You’re Gao Erhei’s father?”
Gao Laohan replied, “Yes.”
“I heard that you obtained a little girl for Gao Erhei, and want them to get married?”
“Yes!”
“How old is the little girl?”
“She came to our home three years ago, and she is twelve years old now.”
The district chief stood up and said, “Girls cannot marry until they are fifteen, do you understand?
Hurry and send the girl back to her home! Gao Erhei wants to marry Duoxi!”
Gao Laohan was a little scared and said, “She only has a father, and I don’t know where he went.
She doesn’t have a home. I don’t know where to send her back to!
Girls can’t marry until they are fifteen … well yes, that’s technically true!
But District Chief, you know that in the village it’s very common to obtain a little girl and then marry them after they grow up.
District Chief, please help us out. If you don’t say anything, then it will end like this …”
“No way! Marriage is between two people. If one person is unwilling, then the marriage cannot happen!”
The district chief was a little angry.
Gao Laohan said, “It’s okay. In this case, everyone is willing.”
“Everyone is willing?” The district chief looked towards Little Erhei and asked, ..
.. “Gao Erhei, are you willing to get married to the little girl in your home?”
Little Erhei said loudly, “No, I am not willing!”
Gao Laohan became angry, looked towards Little Erhei, and spoke much more loudly, ..
.. “Don’t say a word! This matter is not for you to decide!”
“Then is it for you to decide?” The district chief said, ..
.. “His own marriage is not up for him to decide yet it’s up to you to decide?
Oh, Laohan, did you know, things are different now than they were in the past?
Now it’s no longer up to the parents to decide to whom their children get married.
Children can decide whom they date and whom they marry.
The little girl you are raising, if she really doesn’t have a home, then she can just be your daughter.”
Gao Laohan heard what the district chief had to say and had nothing to counter with.
He said, “It’s fine if he doesn’t want to get married to the little girl in my home.
But District Chief, please do me a favor. Don’t let him get married to Sanhua’s daughter!”
The district chief said, “But this is not something I can control.”
Gao Laohan was so worried he wanted to cry,
“No! No! Their birthdays are not suitable for marriage. It says so in the fortune-telling book!
They really can’t get married! Please help me, District Chief!”
Then, he turned towards Little Erhei and said, ..
.. “Erhei, I’ve read the fortunes for your birthdays many times; they’re really not suitable for marriage!”
“Not suitable?” The district chief said, ..
.. “You want a nineteen-year-old child to marry that twelve-year-old little girl of yours.
Surely, this is what is not suitable?
In reality, as long as Gao Erhei and Duoxi want to get married, ..
.. it doesn’t matter whether you agree or disagree. Go home now!”
After he finished speaking, he had someone see Gao Laohan out.
